## Mental‑Health Journal App – *“MindLog” (Beta Draft)* > **Goal:** A lightweight, privacy‑first journal that lets users track how they feel each day, spot patterns, and get gentle insight or prompts without turning the app into a therapy tool. --- ## 1. Core Value‑Proposition | **User Need** | **App Feature** | |----------------|-----------------| | Safe private space for daily check‑in | End‑to‑end encryption, local‑only data storage (optionally sync via secret passphrase) | | Easy entry workflow | One‑tap “Today’s Mood” + word‑prompt field | | Visual pattern recognition | Daily/weekly trend graphs, heat‑map calendar | | Slow‑down & reflection | AI‑generated “Reflection Prompt” (optional, opt‑out) | | Help in crisis | Built‑in “Crisis Toolkit” button with phonebook & emergency options | --- ## 2. High‑Level Architecture ``` ┌─────────────────┐ HTTPS ┌─────────────────────┐ │ Mobile Client │◄──────────►│ REST/GRPC API (TLS) │ └─────────────────┘ └-----------------------┘ ▲ ▲ ▼ ▼ Local SQLite/Encrypted DB Cloud Firestore/SQL ``` * **Mobile client** – iOS & Android native widget, built in SwiftUI & Jetpack Compose or cross‑platform Flutter/React‑Native if budget needed. * **Local encryption** – `SQLCipher` or `EncryptedSharedPreferences`, 256‑bit AES. * **Cloud sync** – optional, user‑controlled. Strong access control with Firebase Auth + optional 2FA. * **Backend** – minimal, just CRUD + analytics + crash/logging. Could be Firebase Functions + Firestore or a small Node.js/Express server on Netlify. > **Data Flow** > 1. User writes entry → immediately saved locally (offline-first). > 2. When online, sync to cloud with passive background sync, *only* if `Sync` toggle is on. > 3. All communication over TLS, nothing plain‑text exposed. --- ## 3. UX / UI Sketch | **Screen** | **Key Elements** | **Interaction** | |------------|------------------|-----------------| | **Launch / Onboard** | 1‑3 slide intro + privacy notice + “Agree & Continue” | Swipe or tap. | | **Home Feed** | • Daily Mood Carousel (emoji + timestamp)
• “Add Entry” floating button | Scroll up to see history. | | **Today’s Entry** | • Date header
• Mood selector (emoji scale 1‑5)
• Text box “How did you feel today?”
• “Save” button (auto‑save, shows progress) | Auto‑save every 5 s. | | **Reflection Prompt** (optional) | • One sentence query (e.g., “What was the most challenging moment today?”)
• Text field | Shown after Save if opted‑in. | | **Calendar View** | • Heat‑map square per day colored by mood score | Tap day → expand card. | | **Stats & Trends** | • Line chart of mood over 1‑month, 3‑month | Pinch‑zoom, legend toggle. | | **Crisis Toolkit** | • Immediate call + SOS button
• Local help resources | One‑tap, short‑delay confirmation. | | **Settings** | • Data export (CSV, PDF)
• Sync toggle
• Security (Passcode / FaceID) | UI for enabling/disabling, copy export URL. | **Design Principles** * **Minimalist** – avoid clutter, focus on single entry per screen. * **Color‑blind friendly** – use patterns + color. * **Dark mode** – optional toggle. * **Accessibility** – voice‑over support, Haptic feedback for events. --- ## 4. Key Technical Choices | Area | Recommended Stack | Why | |------|-------------------|-----| | **Flutter** | `flutter` + `sqflite` + `encrypt` | Same codebase, quick cross‑platform. | | **Native** | SwiftUI + CoreData + Keychain (iOS)
Kotlin + Room + EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) | Highest performance, tight integration. | | **Cloud** | Firebase Auth + Cloud Firestore + Firebase Functions | No‑SQL sync, real‑time, secure. | | **Analytics** | Optional, anonymized anonymized self‑tracked metrics (Mood trends) | Keep_user stall to avoid ML. | | **Testing** | Unit + Widget tests (Flutter), Espresso & XCTest (Native) | Ensure reliability. | | **Security Feature** | Implementation | |----------------------|----------------| | **Local encryption** | 256‑bit AES on DB files + passphrase. | | **Passcode / Biometric** | Keychain unlock for app & encryption key. | | **Data export** | GZip + base64 to avoid being parsed by third parties. | | **No third‑party tracking** | No ads, no analytics trackers, no crash reporting that shares PII. | --- ## 5. Development Roadmap | Milestone | Time | Deliverable | |-----------|------|-------------| | **MVP** | 6–8 weeks | 1️⃣ Onboarding + Home screen ⬆ 2️⃣ Entry screen + local DB ⬆ 3️⃣ Calendar & stats | | **Beta** | 4 weeks | Crash protection, passcode, 2FA, basic sync | | **Soft‑Launch** | 2 weeks | QA, feedback loop, UI polish | | **Full Launch** | 2 weeks | Marketing assets, App Store & Play Store release | --- ## 6. Post‑Launch Enhancements 1. **AI Companion** – Autogenerate weekly summary (no personal data sent) using on‑device ML (CoreML/Fastai). 2. **Community** – Optional anonymous posts about coping strategies. 3. **Integrations** – Export to Google Calendar, Apple Health (sleep). 4. **Gamification** – Badges for streaks (optional, privacy‑first). --- ## 7. Legal & Ethical Checklist | Item | Action | |------|--------| | GDPR / CCPA | Explicit opt‑in for data collection, right to delete. | | HIPAA (USA) | Avoid storing PHI unless you have a HIPAA‑compliant backend; keep data user‑controlled. | | Accessibility | WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. | | Crisis Disclosure | Include disclaimer: *“App not a substitute for professional mental health care.”* | | Content Warning | Prompt users about sensitive content. | --- ## 8.
